newsitem.title: USA: No Fed action seen; Fed funds at 5-1/4 percent.
newsitem.headline: No Fed action seen; Fed funds at 5-1/4 percent.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to stay out of the open market on Tuesday, despite the Fed having a sizable add need, analysts said.

Since the Fed injected reserves via four-day fixed system repurchase agreements on Monday, that took care of the add need for Tuesday, economists agreed. Further, Federal funds opened at the 5-1/4 percent target rate and have traded at that level so far this morning, giving the Fed another reason to stay on the sidelines.
But, with a projected $3.5-$4 billion daily add need this period, analysts see the Fed adding reserves on Wednesday.
